title: 第2章 发小的妻子
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
至于后面的场景，她只剩下模糊的片段，隐约记得那个男人长得还算帅气，眉眼干净，可动作却异常粗暴，像是带着一股莫名的戾气，每一下都让她难以承受。

    苏冰越想越气，猛地抓起床头的手机，快速拨通了助手杨婷的电话，语气冰冷得没有一丝温度：“马上带一套衣服来酒店，302房间，快点！”

    没过十分钟，一身白领套装的杨婷就匆匆赶了过来，手里抱着一个精致的服装袋。

    一推开门，看到房间里凌乱的床单、散落的纸条碎片，还有苏冰苍白愤怒的脸色，杨婷瞬间傻眼了，手里的袋子差点掉在地上。

    她快步走上前，满脸担忧地看着苏冰，语气急切：“总裁，你怎么了？出什么事了？”

    苏冰抬眸，眼神冰冷刺骨，语气里满是恨意，一字一句说：“给我查，动用所有关系，我要知道昨晚那个男人是谁，我要他付出代价！”

    杨婷浑身一僵，脸上写满了难以置信。

    总裁竟然连昨晚和她睡在一起的男人是谁都不知道？

    愣了几秒后，她才反应过来，连忙点头，语气恭敬又急切：“是，总裁，我马上查，一定尽快给您答复！”

    说着，她立刻拿出手机，快速拨通了电话，压低声音交代着查人的事宜。

    苏冰靠在床头，双手紧紧攥成拳头，指甲几乎要嵌进肉里：“你给我等着，回头我定要让你付出代价，将你碎尸万段！”

    ……

    与此同时，陈阳来到了不远处的赌石街。

    这条街不算宽敞，两旁摆满了大大小小的赌石摊位，人声鼎沸，叫卖声、讨价还价声此起彼伏，空气中夹杂着石头的粗糙气息和人们的燥热。

    陈阳走在人群中，眉头微微蹙着，心底对唐欣悦的愧疚依旧萦绕不散。

    但他反复告诉自己，昨晚的事并非他本意，他也是醉酒后失控，算不上真正意义上的背叛。

    这样一想，心底的愧疚才稍稍减轻了一些。

    他又暗暗下定决心，一定要做点什么事，来弥补对唐欣悦的亏欠。

    这时，陈阳目光扫过路边的赌石摊位，双眼不由一亮！

    对了，他有透视眼啊！

    凭借这神通，赌石肯定能一扫一个准。
content_en:
As for the subsequent scene, she only had vague fragments left. She vaguely remembered that the man was quite handsome, with clean eyebrows, but his movements were extremely rough, as if he had an inexplicable anger, and every move was unbearable for her.

The more Su Bing thought about it, the angrier she became. She grabbed the phone on the bedside and quickly dialed the number of her assistant Yang Ting. Her tone was so cold that there was no warmth at all: "Bring a set of clothes to the hotel immediately, room 302, hurry up!"

Within ten minutes, Yang Ting, dressed in a white-collar suit, hurried over, holding an exquisite clothing bag in her hand.

As soon as she opened the door, she saw the messy sheets, scattered pieces of paper, and Su Bing's pale and angry face in the room. Yang Ting was stunned for a moment, and she almost dropped the bag in her hand.

She walked forward quickly, looked at Su Bing with worry on her face, and said urgently: "President, what's wrong with you? What happened?"

Su Bing raised her eyes, her eyes were cold and biting, her tone was full of hatred, and she said word by word: "Check it out for me, use all your connections, I want to know who the man was last night, and I want him to pay the price!"

Yang Ting froze, her face filled with disbelief.

The CEO didn't even know who the man she slept with last night was?

After being stunned for a few seconds, she came to her senses, nodded quickly, and said in a respectful and eager tone: "Yes, President, I will check it right away and I will reply to you as soon as possible!"

As she said that, she immediately took out her mobile phone, quickly dialed the number, and explained in a low voice the matter of checking people.

Su Bing leaned on the head of the bed, clenching her hands tightly into fists, her nails almost digging into her flesh: "Just wait for me, I will make you pay the price later and cut you into pieces!"

…

At the same time, Chen Yang came to Gambling Street not far away.

This street is not very spacious. Both sides are lined with large and small stone gambling stalls. The streets are bustling with people, the sounds of hawking and bargaining come and go. The air is mixed with the rough smell of stones and the heat of people.

Chen Yang walked among the crowd, his brows furrowed slightly, and the guilt for Tang Xinyue still lingered in his heart.

But he repeatedly told himself that what happened last night was not his intention. He also lost control after being drunk, so it was not a betrayal in the true sense.

Thinking about it this way, the guilt in my heart eased a little.

He secretly made up his mind to do something to make up for his debt to Tang Xinyue.

At this time, Chen Yang glanced at the stone gambling stalls on the roadside, and his eyes couldn't help but light up!

By the way, he has clairvoyance!

With this magical power, Gambling Stone will definitely be able to sweep it away accurately.
